item.title: Flood submerges houses, shops, farms in FCT community
item.description: Several houses, shops and farmlands have been submerged following a heavy downpour that triggered flooding in Sheda community, Kwali Area Council of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT). Abuja Metro ...
